test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: National Testing Agency (NTA) was established in the year _______ to Conduct entrance examinations.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2017**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• It is an Indian government agency that has been recognised by the Union Council of Ministers and instituted in November 2017.
 
• The National Testing Agency (NTA) is set to conduct various entrance examinations nationwide.
 
• NTA is accountable for conducting the Joint Entrance Examination – Main (JEE Main), National Eligibility cum Entrance Test -Undergraduate (NEET-UG), National Eligibility Test (NET).
 
• It is also responsible to conduct, Common Management Admission Test (CMAT) and Graduate Pharmacy Aptitude Test (GPAT).
 
• The Motto of the National Testing Agency (NTA) is Excellence in Assessment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

About National Testing Agency (NTA):

 
• It is a specialist, premier, autonomous and self-sustained testing organization in the country.
 
• IT conducts tests for entrance or admissions and fellowships in higher educational institutions.
 
• It is registered as a society under Societies Registration Act, 1860. 
 
• It is chaired by an eminent educationist appointed by the Ministry of Education.
 
• It conducts the following major examinations:
 
 
• National Eligibility-cum-Entrance Test (NEET)
 
• Joint Entrance Examination (JEE Mains)
 
• UGC - National Eligibility Test (NET)
 
• Common Management Admission Test (CMAT)
 
• Graduate Pharmacy Aptitude Test (GPAT).
 
 

Objectives of the agency:

 
• Conducting examinations and tests in an efficient and transparent manner.
 
• Design tests in a more rational, scientific manner that suits the needs of the time and demands. 
 
• Assessing students on the basis of their critical analysis levels rather than rote-learning.
 
• Train subject matter experts (SMEs) for the setting of syllabus, question papers and effective solutions for the same in a timely manner.
 
• Collaboration with psychometricians to ensure that the tests are a balance of all the requisite skills for the respective disciplines.

Functions of the agency:

 
• Collaboration, coordination and monitoring of the existing schools and other educational institutions that can help conduct the examination.
 
• Curate an R&D ecosystem within the agency as well as partner with elite academicians, subject matter experts, psychologists, etc.
 
• Assist individual institutions throughout the process from the centre exam ready to actually conducting the exam hassle-free.
 
• Knowledge exchange between domestic and international experts in students assessments, like ETS, etc. for developing a state-of-the-art testing culture in the country.
 
• Undertake any other examination series or tests as instructed by the Ministries or other government departments or even state governments.
 
• Undertake capacity building, reforms and training of school boards, faculty members and non-teaching members to commensurate their testing standards to that of the entrance exam levels for the students.
